business_summary: Midland States Bancorp, Inc. operates as a financial holding company for Midland States Bank that provides various banking products and services to individuals, businesses, municipalities, and other entities. It operates in Banking and Wealth Management segments. The company offers commercial loans; commercial real estate loans that include various property types, such as owner-occupied offices, warehouses and production facilities, office buildings, hotels, mixed-use residential and commercial facilities, retail centers, multifamily properties, assisted living facilities, and farmland; construction and land development loans, including loans to small and midsized businesses to construct owner-user properties, loans to developers of commercial real estate investment properties and residential developments, and loans to individual clients for construction of single family homes; and residential real estate loans comprising first and second mortgage loans, and home equity lines of credit. It also provides commercial equipment leasing; depository products consisting of checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposits, and sweep accounts; and trust and wealth management products and services, such as financial and estate planning, trustee and custodial services, investment management, tax and insurance planning, business planning, corporate retirement plan consulting and administration, and retail brokerage services. The company was founded in 1881 and is headquartered in Effingham, Illinois.
business_summary_ko: Midland States Bancorp, Inc.는 개인, 기업, 지방자치단체 및 기타 단체에 다양한 금융 상품과 서비스를 제공하는 Midland States Bank의 금융 지주 회사로 운영됩니다. 은행 및 자산 관리 부문에서 운영됩니다. 회사는 상업 대출을 제공합니다. 자가 거주 사무실, 창고 및 생산 시설, 사무실 건물, 호텔, 복합 주거 및 상업 시설, 소매 센터, 다세대 부동산, 생활 보조 시설, 농지 등 다양한 유형의 부동산을 포함하는 상업용 부동산 대출; 주택 건설을 위한 중소기업 대출, 상업용 부동산 투자 부동산 및 주거 개발 개발자에 대한 대출, 단독 주택 건설을 위한 개인 고객에 대한 대출을 포함한 건설 및 토지 개발 대출; 및 1차 및 2차 모기지 대출과 주택 담보 신용 한도를 포함하는 주거용 부동산 대출이 포함됩니다. 또한 상업용 장비 임대도 제공합니다. 당좌예금, 저축, 단기금융시장, 예금증서, 스윕계좌로 구성된 예금상품; 신뢰와 자산관리를 생산합니다.
